t: Enquiry From The Netherlands Consulate General Re Miss E. Lovreglio

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
File No.
REGISTRY
SECTION E
Date October 28, 1933

Subject (in full) Enquiry from the Netherlands Consulate-General re:
Miss E. Lovreglio.

Made by D.S.Prokofiev Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the letter dated October 26,1933,
from the Netherlands Consulate-General on the subject of Miss
Eleuterio Lovreglio, I have to state that this individual was
one of the party of ten foreigners of either French or Italian
nationality who under the leadership of one H.M.Chauve,arrived in
Shanghai on July 25,1933 by the s.s." Triton ". They travelled
1-st class from Marseilles and their passports bear a visa of
the Chinese Consulate of that port issued on June 1,1933. They
appeared to be of a respectable class and each declared that the
sole object in making the journey to China was to fulfil a desire
to embrace the Buddist faith and later fo become monks and nuns
under the direction of Ignatius Trebitch Lincoln alias Chao Kung
( 照 空 ). The latter, accompanied by some thirty Chinese
members of the China Buddist Monastery, personally welcomed the
members of the party.

Miss E.Lovreglio,33, travelled on Italian passport
No A.781402,Reg.No 7174-19 ,issued on June 18,1930,by the Italian
Consulate at Nice,France. She gave her home address as No 20 Rue
Michel Ange, Nice and stated that she was a pianist by profession.
Miss Angela Stavolone Lovreglio,35, believed to be the sister of
Miss E.Lovreglio, was also among the party which arrived by the
s.s. " Triton".

According to our information they resided at No 131
Great Western Road until August 26, when they removed to
Mrs Pashe's boarding-house,No 47 Rue Amiral Courbet, their pre-
sent address.

Nothing detrimental is known by this office regarding
Miss E. Lovreglio.
G. Prokofiew
D.S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（左侧手写批注）：
Mr Yao,
Please
and write
saying that
nothing is
known against
this lady, and
a copy of the
report for
intelligence.
[Signature]
29/10.
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
档案号
登记科
E 组
日期：1933年10月28日

事由（全称）：荷兰总领事馆关于 E. Lovreglio 小姐的查询。

由 D.S. Prokofiev 呈报 转交人 [签名]

兹就荷兰总领事馆1933年10月26日来函，提及 Eleuterio Lovreglio 小姐一事，本人谨陈述如下：该人士系十名法籍或意籍外国人之一，在一名叫 H.M. Chauve 的人带领下，于1933年7月25日乘“特里同”号（s.s. "Triton"）轮抵达上海。他们从马赛乘坐头等舱前来，其护照上持有该港口中国领事馆于1933年6月1日签发的签证。他们看似体面人士，每人均宣称前往中国的唯一目的是为了实现信奉佛教的愿望，并随后在 Ignatius Trebitch Lincoln（别名 Chao Kung，即照空）的指导下成为僧侣和尼姑。后者在中国佛教寺院约三十名中国成员的陪同下，亲自迎接了该团成员。

E. Lovreglio 小姐，33岁，持意大利护照，号码 A.781402，注册号 7174-19，由法国尼斯的意大利领事馆于1930年6月18日签发。她提供的家庭住址为尼斯米歇尔·安热路（Rue Michel Ange）20号，并称其职业为钢琴家。Angela Stavolone Lovreglio 小姐，35岁，据信为 E. Lovreglio 小姐的姐妹，也在乘“特里同”号轮抵达的成员之列。

据我方掌握的信息，他们一直居住在大西路（Great Western Road）131号，直至8月26日搬至库尔贝海军上将路（Rue Amiral Courbet）47号 Pashe 太太的寄宿公寓，此为其现住址。

本处未发现有关 E. Lovreglio 小姐的任何不利记录。
G. Prokofiew
副督察

特别课主管警官。

（左侧手写批注）：
姚先生，
请
并复函
称对该
女士并无
不良记录，
另附报告
副本供情
报参考。
[签名]
10/29。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 3179.

SHANGHAI, 26 October 1933

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that I received an
application for a visa to Netherlands India from: Eleuterio
LOVAGLIO, of Italian nationality, born at Naples, 22
February 1900, a composer, temporarily residing at Rue
Amiral Courbet No. 47, holding a passport issued by the
Italian Consulate General at Nice on, 18 June **〔此处转录不清〕**, No.
A. 781402, Reg. No. 7174-19, made valid for travelling to
Netherlands India by the local Italian Consulate General
on 16 October 1933.

I would be much obliged to know whether anything is
known against this person from a political or moral point
of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

**〔签名〕**
Chinese Secretary.

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

S2, For submission please
**〔签名〕** **〔签名〕** 27/10/33

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA。

第 3179 号。

上海，1933年10月26日

先生：

谨通知阁下，本人收到以下人士申请前往荷属东印度的签证：Eleuterio LOVAGLIO，意大利国籍，1900年2月22日出生于那不勒斯，作曲家，暂居库尔贝海军上将路（Rue Amiral Courbet）47号，持有法国尼斯意大利总领事馆于19**〔此处转录不清〕**年6月18日签发的护照，号码 A. 781402，注册号 7174-19，该护照已由当地意大利总领事馆于1933年10月16日加注有效，以便前往荷属东印度。

如从政治或道德角度知晓对该人有任何不利情况，恳请告知，不胜感激。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

**〔签名〕**
中文秘书。

T. P. Givens 先生，
特别课主管警官，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

S2，请提交

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 3229.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REGISTRY.
D. 5385
11 / 1 / 33

SHANGHAI, 1st November 1933.

Sir,

With reference to your letter of 30 October 1933, No.
D. 5385 I have the honour to inform you that I had a visit
from Mr. (not Miss) Lovreglio, who stated that he found life
in Chao Kung's monastery unsuitable for him although he made
two attempts to conform himself to the discipline established
there. His wife, with whom he has been married for nine years,
however appears to have absolutely broken with him and her own
family and intends to stay in China.

Lovreglio makes the impression of being a serious person,
who has stated that he never has had anything to do with
politics and that he has always entertained good relations
with the officials of his own country. I have advised him
however not to proceed to Netherlands India before I have
consulted the Immigration authorities in Batavia on the desira-
bility of his admission there.

Should in the mean time any information to his detriment
come to your knowledge, I should be very grateful, if I could
be informed.

（批：Reg. Please acknowledge and say we will do so TPG 10/33）

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
〔签名〕
Chinese Secretary.

T.P. Givens, Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA。

第 3229 号。

上海公共租界工部局警务处
登记科。
D. 5385
1933年11月1日

上海，1933年11月1日。

先生：

兹复阁下1933年10月30日第 D. 5385 号来函，谨告知阁下，Lovreglio 先生（非小姐）曾来访，他表示尽管两次尝试适应照空寺院中建立的戒律，但仍觉得那里的生活不适合他。然而，与他结婚九年的妻子似乎已与他及其娘家彻底决裂，并打算留在中国。

Lovreglio 给人的印象是一个严肃的人，他声称自己从未涉足政治，且始终与本国官员保持良好关系。不过，我已建议他在未就其入境适宜性咨询巴达维亚（Batavia）移民当局之前，不要前往荷属东印度。

在此期间，若阁下知悉任何对他不利的信息，如能告知，我将不胜感激。

（批：登记。请复函称我们将照办 TPG 1933年10月）

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
〔签名〕
中文秘书。

T.P. Givens 先生，
特别课主管警官，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

October 30 33.

**〔此处转录不清〕**

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt
of your letter No. 3179 dated October 26, and to
forward herewith for your confidential information
a copy of a report regarding Miss E. Lovreglio.
There is nothing in the Police records against this
person.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Officer i/c Special Branch.

J. Van den Berg, Esq.,
Netherlands Consulate-General.
pages.zh:
1933年10月30日。

**〔此处转录不清〕**

先生：

谨确认收到阁下10月26日第3179号来函，并随函附上关于 E. Lovreglio 小姐的报告副本，供阁下机密参考。警方档案中并无对该人不利的记录。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

特别课主管警官。

J. Van den Berg 先生，
荷兰总领事馆。
